verdict.rationale: AMD's first-party ROCm stack documents running GPU workloads on the RX 9070 XT without a desktop UI. It covers Docker containers with GPU device passthrough, prebuilt vLLM and SGLang Docker images, and offline runfile installs, which together support headless, reproducible automation. Nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines or GPU CI runners specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration docs or examples, any headless-operation guidance for this consumer card, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated or CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Docker is a popular way to run ROCm workloads in a consistent, reproducible environment.
passes GPU device nodes directly to the container with `--device`. No toolkit required.
This page describes how to set up and run vLLM on AMD GPUs and APUs using either a prebuilt Docker image (recommended) or pip.
The key advantage of using the ROCm Runfile Installer is its offline installation support.
